ackQueued: {u} thank you! 🎁 It's busy right now, so you're in the queue. Your Wrapped is on its way.
success:
{u} here's your Fediverse Wrapped 🎁

365 days, all from your public posts. Times in {timeZone}.

Which tile surprised you?

{tail}
dailyLimitOk:
{u} you already got today's Wrapped 🎁 {previous}

Once a day is plenty. Come back tomorrow for a fresh one. ✨
dailyLimitRetry: {u} the bot already tried for you today and it didn't work out. Come back tomorrow and it will give it another go. ✨
dailyLimitPending: {u} your Wrapped is already in the works and coming as soon as the bot is done. 🎁
noPostsEver: {u} the bot couldn't find any public posts from you yet. Post something public and come back, your Wrapped will be waiting!
noPostsInWindow: {u} you have public posts, but none from the last 12 months. Your Wrapped would be a very quiet one! Post something and mention the bot again.
outboxForbidden: {u} the bot isn't allowed to read your posts. Your server only hands them to servers it already knows, or it doesn't share outboxes at all. Nothing you did wrong!
outboxNotPublished: {u} your server runs {software}, and {software} doesn't publish posts in the ActivityPub outbox the bot reads, so there's nothing to wrap, however much you post. Nothing you did wrong!
outboxGone: {u} the bot can't find your posts at that address any more. If you moved accounts recently, try again from your new one!
outboxUnreadable: {u} your server answered, but not in a way the bot could read. That's usually a hiccup, so try again later!
outboxUnavailable: {u} the bot can't get to your public posts. That's not on you. Try again later!
rateLimited: {u} your server is asking the bot to slow down right now. Mention the bot again in about an hour!
hostUnavailable: {u} the bot can't reach your server at the moment. Try again later!
internalError: {u} something broke on the bot's side, not yours. Try again tomorrow, and if it keeps failing, write to {contact}.
dmTail: Want a version you can boost? Just mention the bot publicly.
partialLine: Your year was too big for the bot 😅 Numbers are a lower bound.
engagementLine: Your server doesn't publish favourite and boost counts over ActivityPub, so those stats aren't here.
tzHintLine: Different timezone? Add tz=America/New_York next time.
